purpose: Prevent false non-events and reporting/camera availability leakage in Jubilee validation while supporting fully unattended prospective control collection.
observed_non_event_visible_scope_require: Known observation effort in the target shoreline cell and predawn/dawn window.
At least one qualified direct camera or other independently documented observation channel was actually available, fresh and capable of resolving the relevant visible scope.
No confirmed Jubilee evidence in that visible/observed scope and interval.
View quality was sufficient to detect the class of event being labeled absent.
No source outage, darkness, obstruction, stale/frozen frame or unverified report gap is being reinterpreted as a negative.
The negative label is geometrically scoped; it cannot be promoted from one visible beach/pier/marina frame to an entire shoreline cell without independent coverage.

camera_specific_rules.montrose_shoreline: A fresh, unobstructed first-light/dawn view with moderate/high detectability can generate an observed_non_event_visible_scope for the 437 beach segments actually visible. Full-darkness biology is UNKNOWN. This does not establish a negative for all Montrose/May Day/Fly Creek.
camera_specific_rules.montrose_pier_views: Supporting very-shallow-water observation effort only; no direct swash-zone negative by themselves.
camera_specific_rules.point_clear_owner_cluster: The three marina/Bay views improve observation effort but do not provide a close Point Clear beach/swash-zone negative. Dark views are UNKNOWN and the cluster cannot by itself establish a full-cell non-event.
camera_specific_rules.fairhope_pier_public: Pier activity/environment proxy only. No north- or south-beach Jubilee negative may be inferred because those beaches are outside the field of view.
camera_specific_rules.grand_hotel_public: A negative applies only to the WSW water/activity actually visible in-frame; unseen Grand Hotel/Point Clear/Zundel's/Mullet Point shoreline cannot be labeled negative.

owner_field_work_policy.reason: Owner does not plan routine in-person predawn spot checks; prospective controls must be collectable unattended.
owner_field_work_policy.incidental_owner_or_trusted_local_observ: May be recorded when it occurs, with provenance and observation effort, but is not required for the control pipeline.

scientific_near_miss_rule: The 1971-08-16 south-of-Great-Point-Clear May observation is preserved as a scientifically observed near-miss because severe offshore hypoxia approached the coast but no Jubilee occurred. It is not automatically a generic matched negative until clock window, tide/current phase and spatial observation basis are reconstructed.
leakage_rules: Do not use information first available after forecast issuance as a predictor for that forecast.
Same-day public reports may be used only in a detection/nowcast layer if available_at precedes the forecast timestamp.
Do not allow event-driven extra observation effort to make positives look systematically better observed than controls without explicit detectability adjustment.
No-report days are UNKNOWN unless observation effort meets the observed_non_event_visible_scope requirements.
Preserve source/camera availability and detectability as observation-process variables so the physical model cannot learn reporting infrastructure as Jubilee physics.

prospective_control_strategy.preferred_window: same pre-dawn/dawn windows used by Jubilee Dawn Timing
prospective_control_strategy.method: Log camera health, illumination/view quality, structured public-camera observations, social-search effort and environmental-source availability regardless of model risk. Later match only eligible visible-scope non-events to confirmed event mornings on season, clock window, tide/current phase and observation availability.
prospective_control_strategy.highest_quality_initial_control_source: 437 montrose_shoreline after first usable light because it directly resolves the waterline and has a known narrow negative scope.
